title: Development of Precipitation-Strengthened Al0.8NbTiVM (M = Co, Ni) Light-Weight Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
process_method_2: vacuum arc melting + suction casting-heat treatment
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting with Ti, Nb, V, Al, Co, and Ni elements of 99.95 wt.% purity under a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere (99.99%). The ingots were solidified on a water-cooled copper hearth and re-melted more than 8 times by flipping them over to achieve homogenous distribution of elements. The as-cast rod samples were produced by suction casting into a cylindrical Cu mold with 3 mm in diameter and 50 mm in length, followed by heat treatment at 1100 °C for 1 h in a vacuum-sealed quartz tube with titanium chips to prevent oxidation, then water-quenched.
